task: Implement registry-backed thin prompt assets for Lattice/Koala init without breaking legacy full-mode .Codex/.claude behavior.
outcome: 用户在一个干净测试仓库运行 `lattice init --asset-mode=thin --profile=codex` 后，会看到输出明确说明使用 registry-backed prompts，项目中只生成 KOALA.md、AGENTS.md、.Codex/README.md、.Codex/koala.json 和 launcher，不再生成整套 .Codex/agents prompt copies；随后运行 `lattice check --profile=codex` 和 `node bin/koala-codex.js verify_codex` 都通过。用户在旧 full-mode 仓库运行原有命令时，输出仍然是通过或只出现原有 drift，不会因为 thin mode 变化而失败。
facts: Prompt templates already live in packages/main/templates/agents.
Current init materializes .Codex/agents as rendered Markdown copies and .claude/agents as symlinks.
Current verify_codex hard-checks legacy mirror presence and equality.
Managed assets contract requires conservative no-overwrite behavior for local edits.
Non-JS repositories must remain lightweight and cannot be forced to carry runtime dependencies.
constraints: Do not break legacy full mode or existing .Codex/.claude projects.
Do not remove prompt files automatically unless Koala can prove they are safe generated assets.
Keep process-event Codex adapter verification evidence consumable by REVIEW/DONE gates.
Do not rely on absolute symlinks as the only cross-machine representation.
All story and checklist mutations must use Koala CLI.
unknowns: Whether future host runtimes will require materialized prompt files for native discovery remains host-specific.
Whether default init profile should switch in this story or only thin mode opt-in should be introduced depends on compatibility test results.
